generated_note: Status is verified, not claimed. `used` means it ran and there is output in the repository. `unavailable` means we tried and it did not work, with the error recorded — which our own AGENTS.md requires rather than replacing with a plausible summary.

entries.what: Ranks the synonymous codon options and the silent blocking-mutation sets for an edit plan by genomic-language-model likelihood, and scores the edited locus against the reference.
entries.evidence: Live against health.api.nvidia.com/v1/biology/arc/evo2-40b/generate. On kcnk5b p.W169L the edit lowers locus likelihood by 0.184 per base, and Evo2's codon preference DISAGREES with our hand rule — it puts CTT first, which our rule ranked fifth of six.
entries.limit: It RANKS, it never GATES. A likelihood says the sequence looks like the genomes the model was trained on. It is not a phenotype prediction, not evidence of safety, not evidence of specificity, and not calibrated — no threshold is asserted anywhere.
entries.note: There is no scoring route on the NIM (/score, /logits, /embeddings all 404; /forward returns layer activations). The likelihood is computed by teacher forcing through /generate — one call per base, log-softmax over the 512-wide byte vocabulary, read at the true base. The vocabulary mapping was verified against the live endpoint rather than assumed.

entries.where: literature grounding for claims and cassette design
entries.what: Our own protocol REQUIRES it: AGENTS.md step A2 says every claim must carry an OpenResearch run before it reaches testing.
entries.evidence: Not callable from here. api.alphaxiv.org/v1/* returns 404 (the root returns a placeholder 200); api.openresearch.org does not resolve at all. ZERO run ids are recorded anywhere in the repository.
entries.limit: So the requirement is unmet, and saying so is the honest reading. AGENTS.md itself says a failed run is recorded with its error and never replaced by a plausible-looking summary, and that inventing a run identifier is the most damaging failure available to this pipeline.
entries.note: Literature grounding was done instead against sources we could actually fetch: UniProt (26 call sites), Ensembl (17), NCBI E-utilities (9) and Crossref (2), plus Europe PMC after OpenAlex rate-limited. Every citation in the repo names the source it was fetched from.

entries.what: The design leaves the screen as geometry: a 10-part 1:1 snap kit with a fit-test coupon, a 56-part containment-hierarchy kit at 120 mm, and the whole-animal prototypes.
entries.evidence: Two Arigomphus villosipes hindwings printed at 140 mm, 0.6 mm membrane, 1.5 mm at the main veins — one with venation segmented from a photograph, one with cross veins regenerated by the Hoffmann 2018 rule.
entries.limit: The scan comparison has only passed on a SIMULATED scan, so there is no measured agreement between print and design, or between the two prints. A measured 3.8% size mismatch between design and first print is recorded rather than corrected.

entries.where: throughout, and as the product surface
entries.what: The system is exposed as MCP servers — 58 tools on the engine, 39 hosted — so an agent is a first-class caller rather than a second-class user of a human tool. The swarm benchmark ran three architectures through headless agents.
entries.evidence: 36 benchmark cells, 113 logged calls, $8.35, every call's prompt and raw output on disk.
entries.limit: The benchmark found NO quality separation between single agent, decentralised swarm and centralised organisation at three of its four stages.

entries.what: Answers questions about the project on every page, grounded in a generated context file so it cannot drift from what the pages show.
entries.evidence: Groq primary (gpt-oss-120b, qwen3.8-27b), SambaNova behind it. Live: it gives the real gate numbers, refuses to invent a wet-lab figure, and declines to discuss the Aves holdout.
entries.limit: Keys are held as encrypted Worker secrets and never reach the browser. The route refuses to take a model or system prompt from the client.
entries.note: SambaNova returned 429 on every model at once on the first live call — that limit is per model, not per account, which is why there is a failover list.

entries.what: Registered as a provider in sim-engine/generative/backends/providers.mjs with a health probe and model listing.
